topology: five transistor OTA; NMOS pair, PMOS 1:1 mirror, NMOS tail
ac: 1 Hz to 10 GHz, 120 points/decade; 1 V differential AC at closed-loop DC bias; beta=1; all crossings
loop_pm: separate return ratio: noninverting AC=0; inverting AC=-1V, same follower DC bias and capacitive loading; PM=180+phase(T) at every unity crossing; differential gain uses +/-0.5V
feedback: M1 gate=inp at mirror diode branch gives positive output gain; M2 gate=out gives negative feedback
transient: PULSE(1.0 1.2 1u 1n 1n 3u 6u), stop 7u; max/output timestep 0.5ns, final repeated at 0.25ns
slew: first ordered target-referenced crossings 1.04->1.16V in [1,3.8]us and 1.16->1.04V in [4.001,6.8]us; 0.12V/dt
settled: worst absolute error over [0.8,0.99]us at 1.0V, [3.6,3.9]us at 1.2V, [6.6,6.9]us at 1.0V
saturation: at 1.1V follower OP only: abs(VDS)-abs(model VDSAT) >=0.05V on all five devices
convergence: half-step relative SR difference <=1%; endpoint difference <=0.1mV; same pass verdict
boundary: schematic, deterministic TT; ideal tail gate bias; no PVT, mismatch, noise, layout or PEX
